item.title: UC Irvine Chemists Uncover Early Molecular Changes Behind Age-Related Cataracts
item.description: Irvine, Calif., March 4, 2026 — Cataracts represent a formidable challenge in global health, ranking among the leading causes of blindness worldwide. This common age-related condition leads to the progressive clouding of the eye’s natural lens, impairing vision and quality of life. Despite its prevalence, the microscopic origins of cataract formation remain nuanced and elusive. […]
